title: Beef Sopes
description: A classic Mexican dish featuring crispy sopes topped with seasoned ground beef. Serve with your favorite toppings.
instructions: Preheat a non-stick skillet over medium-high heat.
Cook the ground beef until browned, breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks.
Add the diced onion and cook until translucent.
Add the minced garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add the cumin and chili powder and cook for 1 minute.
Warm the sopes according to package instructions.
Spoon the beef mixture onto the sopes and top with shredded cheese.
Optional: Add diced tomatoes, shredded lettuce, or diced avocado as desired.
